application: relais_github_v3 (log _gestion/plans/relais_github/<date>/<ts>_v3.log). To be applied to the other background loops and to any log that grows.
controle: In full mode: more than one _copie_cloud copy of the same file in a day = a growing log to split.
regle: Every log written by a process that runs during backups is split into files written only once (one per active pass, or per event), never extended. A pass without activity writes nothing; an alert that persists is noted only once. The standard output of a background loop stays empty except on a fatal error.
source: Relay batch 20261016_095006: the relay's log for the day, extended at each pass, was sent each time into a new _copie_cloud_<date>_<HHMM> on the PC (up to 144 copies per day and per log).
titre: A growing file + never overwrite = one copy per backup: write immutable logs
